note: Both sets repeat the same core facts heavily and both mangle the louver height formula (dropping the tan(solar elevation)/Cos(solar…) terms and presenting 'Depth * (azimuth – window azimuth)' as a valid formula), but Set A does so more often and additionally mislabels D*1.2 as a spacing/depth-to-height ratio of 1.2 and invents an 'average' condition for the 25-degree bend. Set B adds correctly bound facts Set A omits (powder-coated finish, screen-level louver profile/shape) and keeps the 1:1 depth-to-height ratio and 50-degree solar altitude with their conditions. Set B's weaknesses are mostly garbled or truncated quotes and one fabricated quote ('the extruded louver profile was…'), whereas Set A contains more substantively wrong value/property bindings.
